verdict.rationale: The docs include a guide to intercept and handle outbound HTTP from sandboxes using Workers, a first-party way to programmatically allow or block egress. However, it is only a one-line mention, appears limited to HTTP, and requires code rather than a declarative policy. A community commenter believed egress control was all-or-nothing, but that was hedged ('as far as I can tell') rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence without creating a dispute. Missing for 10: a documented declarative egress allow/deny policy (domains/IPs), coverage of non-HTTP traffic, in-depth docs on the interception mechanism, and independent hands-on corroboration.
